effect_description_eng:
This card is also treated as [Dorulumon] for a DigiXros.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon can't activate [When Digivolving] effects or unsuspend until the end of their turn.
[On Deletion] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait from your hand or trash under any of your Tamers.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] This Digimon with the [Xros Heart] trait gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.).
